quote: AES Andes announced that its San Matías Wind Farm, located in Los Ángeles, Biobío region, has commenced commercial operation following authorization from the National Electric Coordinator. … San Matías, with a capacity of 78 MW, began construction in late 2022…
note: Opened AES Andes English release 27 Jun 2024 (San Matías COD 78 MW).
